selectionPolicy.hardGates: fixed special-token IDs, zero unknown tokens, and zero NFKC round-trip mismatches on both splits
selectionPolicy.smallerCandidateRule: select the smallest passing candidate with no more than 10% extra validation tokens versus 2,048
selectionPolicy.largerCandidateRule: otherwise select the smallest passing candidate with at least 20% fewer validation tokens versus 2,048
